rationale: This is the internally consistent capitalisation the expensing hypothesis actually implies (add-back in both numerator and capital base), it is not a duplicate of either the numerator-only or stock-as-separate-rank archive entries, and it usefully removes the mechanical tilt toward heavy spenders — though the reviewer should expect it to *weaken* results if the archive's gains came from that tilt rather than from productivity.

This is "Committed Research Programme Profits" with xrd added back to the profit leg, i.e. two already-tested, same-channel R&D proxies (add-back and continuity count) stacked on the same side of the composite, so it is a cosmetic recombination whose outcome is close to mechanically implied by the two parent results.

A five-year minimum of research intensity is a genuinely different statistic from the count or the cumulative stock and directly operationalises the "commitment" claim, but with COALESCE zero-filling the floor collapses to zero for any firm with a single gap year, so in practice the leg will be a heavily tied near-binary variable highly correlated with the already-tested TS_COUNT version.

target_name: Knowledge Stock And Safe Funding Only
rationale: As a deliberate ablation it is the right attribution test and is honestly framed, but on its own R&D-to-assets is a long-published anomaly, so a strong result would be substantially a rediscovery rather than a new cross-theme finding.

A clean one-change test of whether the liquidity leg can be added to the maturity leg without collapsing the Fama-MacBeth slope, but it is close to "Funding Pressure Adjusted Profitability" with only the R&D add-back swapped in, so the incremental information over the two parents is modest.

The stated diagnosis — that the hard-claims leg's strong slope but weak alpha reflected a weak profitability partner — is testable and the substitution is a single controlled change, but the whole batch now consists largely of permutations around the same ~5% alpha family and the marginal payoff from further leg-swapping is diminishing.
